user-provided in-game model: identity, proportions, costume details

tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body neutral visual-novel sprite of Lumine from Genshin Impact. Image 1 is the official portrait, guiding identity, costume and polished anime illustration style. Image 2 is the user-supplied in-game model, guiding accurate face, skin tone, hair, outfit, accessories and colors. Preserve these details faithfully; translate the model to the illustrated style of the official portrait. Use petite Medium Female proportions. Pose: calm and quietly confident, weight gently shifted, her right hand resting lightly at her hip and left arm relaxed at her side, facing generally toward the viewer with a neutral expression and naturally hanging clothing and hair. Separate the right and left hands, naturally articulated, each with a palm, four fingers and a separate opposable thumb, without forcing hidden digits into view. Exactly two legs and two feet belonging to one pelvis, feet comfortably separated. One coherent mouth. No weapon. Full silhouette including hair, headwear, hands and shoes visible, with approximately 2–4% top and bottom padding. Polished anime game artwork on a genuinely transparent background. No scenery, UI, labels, watermark, companions, floating effects or ground shadow.
